company_name.title: Company name
company_name.description: Company name used in Google queries, for example: Techforce Global.

decision_makers_only.title: Decision makers only
decision_makers_only.description: When enabled, only save profiles whose Google snippet or LinkedIn profile text matches decision-maker keywords.

role_keywords.title: Role Keywords
role_keywords.description: Custom title filters used to build Google queries.

max_google_results.title: Maximum profiles
max_google_results.description: Maximum unique LinkedIn profile URLs to collect from Google.

visit_linkedin_profiles.title: Visit LinkedIn profiles
visit_linkedin_profiles.description: Optional enrichment. When disabled, the Actor uses Google result title/snippet only and does not open LinkedIn profiles.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Set false locally if you need to observe Google or LinkedIn pages.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Enable Apify Proxy for browser traffic.

proxy_groups.title: Proxy groups
proxy_groups.description: Apify Proxy groups to use when proxy is enabled. GOOGLE_SERP is recommended for Google search result pages.
